title: Rivet application
description: Creates a Rivet app from one of the create-rivet starters, with Nx targets (inferred or in project.json) and an optional Vitest setup.

directory.description: Project folder, relative to the workspace root (e.g. apps/web).
directory.x-prompt: Which directory do you want to create the application in?

template.description: Starter: static (prerendered pages, Tailwind), server (loader + form action per request, Node), ui (@rivetjs/ui + Tailwind v4), minimal (one page, no Tailwind).

items.label: Node server (loader + form action per request)

adapter.description: node: pages render per request; static: prerendered HTML files. Default: from the template (server → node, others → static).

deploy.description: Platform target, the same files as create-rivet --deploy: rivetRouter({ adapter }) + platform config; Nx targets instead of npm scripts (vercel / cloudflare: deploy; cloudflare / bun / deno: preview). bun and deno need --template=server.

tailwind.description: Tailwind v4. Default: on, except the minimal starter.

unitTestRunner.description: Test runner: vitest.config.ts with rivetTest() and a first test.

addPlugin.description: Use inferred targets (default: true unless NX_ADD_PLUGINS=false).

skipPackageJson.description: Do not add dependencies to the root package.json.

skipInstall.description: Do not run the package manager install.
